name: SaunaLife G3 6-Person Outdoor Pod Cabin Sauna
description: Introducing the SaunaLife G3 Outdoor Home Sauna, a distinctive retreat designed to elevate your backyard experience. The captivating parabolic arched roof not only adds charm but also ensures optimal space utilization, natural heat circulation, and supreme weather protection. Unique Architecture The G3's unique shape combines elegance with efficiency, creating a cozy space that's resistant to the elements. Its full-height shingled roof and recessed front porch provide shelter in all weather conditions, while the durable thermo-pine exterior guarantees years of wellness and relaxation. Premium Outdoor Living The recessed front terrace serves as an inviting space for relaxation and socializing. For wood-fired stove enthusiasts, it's a practical spot to keep firewood dry. The bronze-tinted 8mm tempered glass door adds a touch of modernity and floods the interior with natural light. Ambient Illumination Experience the sauna's beauty in a new light. The included lighting package, controllable via a hand-held remote with a wall mount, bathes the interior in warm, dimmable white light, creating an atmosphere that's both inviting and serene. Transform your backyard into a haven of wellness with the SaunaLife G3 outdoor sauna—a perfect blend of style, functionality, and enduring relaxation for you, your family, and your friends. Features Model G3 Outdoor Home Sauna One-of-a-kind outdoor sauna experience Beautiful and durable Thermo-Spruce exterior Front terrace for socialization or for outdoor self-reflection.
